description: This file defines the Transaction class within the Opencart platform, responsible for sending transaction notification emails to customers after account transactions. It loads necessary models and language resources, prepares email data, and queues email tasks.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Controller class responsible for sending transaction emails to customers upon account activity.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that prepares and queues a transaction email to be sent to the customer, based on transaction data and customer info.
